title: #344 Movie or Television
prompt: Movies and television have a bad influence on people’s behaviors. To what extent do you agree with this statement?

promptSegments.text: Movies and television have a bad influence on people’s behaviors.
To what extent do you agree with this statement?

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Media can teach people bad habits.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Media can teach people bad habits.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Media can negatively affect a person's social life.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Media can negatively affect a person's social life.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Media can teach positive actions by showing good behavior.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Media can teach positive actions by showing good behavior.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Media helps build understanding of other people by showing different cultures.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Media helps build understanding of other people by showing different cultures.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Media content can negatively influence viewers by showing characters engaging in unacceptable actions, leading viewers to perceive these bad habits as normal.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Media content can negatively influence viewers by showing characters engaging in unacceptable actions, leading viewers to perceive these bad habits as normal.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Media can alter people's daily habits because individuals tend to imitate what they see on screen, causing their normal behavior to align with media portrayals.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Media can alter people's daily habits because individuals tend to imitate what they see on screen, causing their normal behavior to align with media portrayals.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Media provides educational value by exposing viewers to diverse cultures and lifestyles.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Media provides educational value by exposing viewers to diverse cultures and lifestyles.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Media consumption can enhance social connections and provide common ground for discussion among people.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Media consumption can enhance social connections and provide common ground for discussion among people.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not explain the statement without making your own position clear.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ giải thích nhận định mà quên nêu rõ quan điểm cá nhân.
